title: Valid Country Codes
applicability: Source-release numeric country recognition for Table 059; general acquirer versus merchant role remains conflicted.
source: Appendix AC-1 through AC-4; Appendix I-64/I-65 Table 059
sourceNotes: All source rows are preserved, including N/A, blank and reference-only entries. Only three-digit numeric entries enter the recognition vector.
840 is assigned to both American Samoa and United States. Numeric recognition is separate from ambiguous country mapping.
Northern Mariana Islands 580 is repeated on AC-2 and AC-4; identical repeated mappings are not treated as conflicting.
Source values 249 France, Metropolitan; 929 Mauritania; 930 Sao Tome and Principe; 900 UNMIK and all historical labels are preserved, not replaced by modern ISO registry values.

Antarctica has no numeric code, Holy See and European Economic and Monetary Union are N/A, and Virgin Islands is a reference. Vatican City State is separately listed as 336. No automatic alias resolution.

AC describes acquiring-institution residence. Appendix I calls Table 059 Soft Descriptor - Merchant Country, with the underlying retailer country for Discover third-party providers. General role semantics remain REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Appendix I prints Table ID attribute n2 with value 059 and Table Length n2 with value 03; do not infer a full wire-header layout from these conflicting widths. Logical data width is three.
Synthetic location evidence is not production boarding, eligibility or current ISO certification.
